page.title: Trademark registration
page.summary: Search, filing, and follow-up for trademarks that protect commercial identity in Mexico.
page.intro: A trademark protects more than a name. We review availability, classes, opposition risk, and commercial use before filing.

cards.title: Availability
cards.description: We identify matches and risk before investing in a public identity.

cards.title: Correct classes
cards.description: Protection depends on classification aligned to the real business.

cards.title: Follow-up
cards.description: We monitor requirements, deadlines, and decisions until there is clarity.

page.trustTitle: Before acting, the matter is organized.
page.trustDescription: Each service starts with context, scope, and a responsible route. Sensitive information is requested only when the channel and objective are clear.

trustItems.title: Clear method
trustItems.description: Facts, documents, deadlines, and risks are separated before recommending an action.

trustItems.title: Information care
trustItems.description: The first contact stays general until scope and channel are confirmed.

trustItems.title: Multilingual attention
trustItems.description: The first approach can be prepared in Spanish, English, or Chinese depending on the matter.

page.moduleTitle: Commercial protection before going to market.
page.moduleDescription: The trademark is prepared as an asset: availability, classes, real use, and authority follow-up.

moduleItems.title: Name risk
moduleItems.description: Phonetic, conceptual, and visual matches are reviewed before filing.

moduleItems.title: Protection classes
moduleItems.description: Coverage is aligned with goods, services, and expected growth.

moduleItems.title: Monitored asset
moduleItems.description: The file is followed with timely responses and clear status reading.

page.ctaTitle: Share the context before deciding the route.
page.ctaDescription: Astra Legal can review general context and identify a responsible next step. Do not send sensitive documents until the channel and scope are confirmed.
